answer: Grading carries stake on its own judgment: an auditor scoring an answer commits a small stake to the outcome; when re-execution confirms or refutes the work, accurate auditors gain a delta of standing and inaccurate ones pay. Lucky guesses wash out over epochs; the ridge between skill and luck sharpens as samples accumulate. Auditors whose accuracy sinks into the ocean of noise lose their seats, and a farm that cross-endorses its own clones loses twice: every wrong call burns its stake, and correlated errors flag the whole cluster. Honest graders compound; fake ones pay to be wrong in public.
